closing.summary: Big strengths are protein, carb quality, and calcium, but the biggest weaknesses are saturated fat, low vitamin A, and low magnesium. It is good for practical meals, muscles, and immune support because the food-type role makes it easy to build meals around, protein still gives it a muscle-support angle, and vitamin A and zinc gives the immune-support side a reason to exist.
